2. Click Menus & Pages on the left side of the Editor.
3. Click the relevant page that isn't displaying your menu.

7. Select Standard.

question: I need help setting up an email for website messages to go to instead of mine.
answer:
To set up an email for website messages to go to instead of yours, you'll need to add a mail-forwarding DNS record. You can do this by going to Do → Other (provider not on the list) and following the steps to get your provider's MX records. After getting your provider's MX records, add the Forwarder DNS record.

A Forwarder DNS record allows you to forward incoming emails from Wix.com to another email address. To set up a mail-forwarding DNS record, go to your email provider's settings and follow their instructions for adding a forwarder record. The steps will vary depending on your email provider, but the general process is:

1. Get your email provider's MX records (and any other necessary DNS records).
2. Go to Do → Other (provider not on the list) and proceed.
3. Follow your email provider's instructions for adding a forwarder record.

Once you've added the forwarder record, Wix will be able to forward website messages to your specified email address instead of yours.
